sources.title: Varus Build Guide: [S2026.19] | EASY-TO-READ ✔️ SIMPLE 1v9 ✔️ LIVE AMA ✔️ [FULL GUIDE] ✔️ [UPDATED]

passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.text: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

spells.name: Piercing Arrow
spells.text: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

spells.name: Blighted Quiver
spells.text: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

spells.name: Hail of Arrows
spells.text: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

spells.name: Chain of Corruption
spells.text: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

damage.value: Varus deals long-range poke and burst with lethality, or sustained damage with on-hit builds.

archetype.value: Varus is an immobile ADC who plays at range and changes his build to suit the fight.

axis.value: Varus pokes with Q in lane or takes short trades with basic attacks into E.

winCondition.value: Varus wins by landing poke before objectives, securing picks with R, or free-hitting in extended fights.

spikes.why: Varus can detonate them with E for a stronger trade.

bait.why: Varus loses lane pressure when Q misses, creating a window while it is unavailable.
After Varus uses Chain of Corruption, its cooldown creates a window without its immobilization.

mistakes.value: Varus players lose pressure by missing Q or risk punishment by mispositioning.
Varus gives up potential range and damage by firing Piercing Arrow before preparing it longer.
